notes: Single-stage: group JSON sync records by (user, field), decide conflicts by value divergence, apply a two-level tie-break (recency then device priority then input order) for the winner, and emit a structured report whose total_conflicts must equal len(conflicts). Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (tie-break cascade), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (hidden tie/duplicate/empty cases), and quantitative_correctness (exact counts and winner identity verified structurally).
